t: Create elegant event pages and manage guests easily
Get a simple interface to create attractive event pages, manage guests, generate invitation messages, QR entry cards, and export content as an HTML file or image—no server required.
Event creator and guest list manager with multiple designs

Create a complete event page and manage guest lists in just a few clicks. Design your event page with multiple themes, add guests and track their RSVP status, generate ready-to-copy invitation messages, create an entry card with a QR code, and manually track payments at check-in. You can also export the page as a standalone HTML file or download the card as an image for easy sharing—all in your browser, with no server or account needed. Enjoy a smooth event planning experience with a clear interface that supports multiple languages and fits seamlessly with the site's overall design.
Enter guest names (one per line: name, email)
Can I change the design after creating the page?
Yes, you can edit the text and change colors using the site's global variables.
How do I add a custom QR code for the event?
Click the "Generate QR code" button and a placeholder code will appear that you can replace manually after downloading.
Does the app support exporting the page as a full image?
The app only lets you download the QR code image; to export the full page as an image, you can use browser tools.
Can I import a guest list from another file?
Yes, use the "Import JSON" button and select the previously saved file.
Is there a limit on the number of guests?
There is no technical limit, but performance may be affected with very large lists.
